description: Points your domain at your Manhattin property website, hosted on Vercel: the root (or a subdomain, applied with host) and optionally www.
variableDescription: %apexIp%: IPv4 address Vercel recommends for the domain (root, or the subdomain given as host); %cnameTarget%: hostname Vercel recommends for www; %vercelVerification%: Vercel ownership token, only when the domain is already used by another Vercel account
